_about: End-to-end cases for the main graph. Each case runs for a fresh demo user on a scratch copy of the database.
history: earlier turns as [role, text]. message: the user's new message; {loan_id} and {loan_title} are filled from the user's first loan.
setup.copies: set total_copies of books before the run. setup.reservations: active reservations the user already has.
expect.intent: accepted intent labels (the label set has no 'availability', so several are acceptable there).
expect.route: which main-graph agents run: none, search, lending, search+lending.
expect.approval: null = no approval request allowed; 'any' = either is fine; otherwise the exact tool and book_id/loan_id.
approve: the answer given to an approval request. Unexpected requests are always declined.
expect.outcome: checks after the run. Cases that expect no approved write also check that the user's loans and reservations are unchanged.
